First, using the laws of logarithms, we observe that

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{1+3x}{1-3x}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+3x)-\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-3x).\end{aligned}
$$

For the expansion of $\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+x),$ we recall the standard result

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+x) & =x-\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}+\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3}-\frac{1}{4}{x}^{4}+\frac{1}{5}{x}^{5}-⋯.\end{aligned}
$$

To obtain the expansion of $\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+3x),$ we replace $x$ with $3x$ in the standard expansion:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+3x) & =(3x)-\frac{1}{2}(3x)^{2}+\frac{1}{3}(3x)^{3}-\frac{1}{4}(3x)^{4}+\frac{1}{5}(3x)^{5}-⋯ \\  & =3x-\frac{1}{2}(9{x}^{2})+\frac{1}{3}(27{x}^{3})-\frac{1}{4}(81{x}^{4})+\frac{1}{5}(243{x}^{5})-⋯ \\  & =3x-\frac{9{x}^{2}}{2}+9{x}^{3}-\frac{81{x}^{4}}{4}+\frac{243{x}^{5}}{5}-⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to obtain the expansion of $\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-3x),$ we replace $x$ with $-3x$ in the standard expansion:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-3x) & =(-3x)-\frac{1}{2}(-3x)^{2}+\frac{1}{3}(-3x)^{3}-\frac{1}{4}(-3x)^{4}+\frac{1}{5}(-3x)^{5}-⋯ \\  & =-3x-\frac{1}{2}(9{x}^{2})+\frac{1}{3}(-27{x}^{3})-\frac{1}{4}(81{x}^{4})+\frac{1}{5}(-243{x}^{5})-⋯ \\  & =-3x-\frac{9{x}^{2}}{2}-9{x}^{3}-\frac{81{x}^{4}}{4}-\frac{243{x}^{5}}{5}-⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we subtract the two series to give the desired result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{1+3x}{1-3x}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+3x)-\operatorname{ln}⁡(1-3x) \\  & =(3x-\frac{9{x}^{2}}{2}+9{x}^{3}-\frac{81{x}^{4}}{4}+\frac{243{x}^{5}}{5}\,-) \\  & -(-3x-\frac{9{x}^{2}}{2}-9{x}^{3}-\frac{81{x}^{4}}{4}-\frac{243{x}^{5}}{5}-⋯) \\  & =(3+3)x+(-\frac{9}{2}+\frac{9}{2}){x}^{2}+(9+9){x}^{3} \\  & +(-\frac{81}{4}+\frac{81}{4}){x}^{4}+(\frac{243}{5}+\frac{243}{5}){x}^{5}+⋯ \\  & =6x+18{x}^{3}+\frac{486{x}^{5}}{5}+⋯\end{aligned}
$$
